user.title: Connect to a Ubiquiti AirOS device
user.description: Enter the device name and HTTP connection details for your AirOS device.

data_description.name: A friendly name to show in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: The device hostname, IP address, or HTTP URL, for example http://192.168.1.20.
data_description.username: The username used to sign in to the AirOS web interface.
data_description.password: The password used to sign in to the AirOS web interface.
